text:
maya_csm: Kickoff: Krypton Analytics pilot. Customer leads: Anya (product) + Ravi (platform). Goal: pilot Redwood for embeddings-driven routing + conversational assistant for internal support. We need to align stakeholders, success metrics, timeline, and renewal signals.

eli_se: Quick infra note 5 5 If they require IP allowlists or private endpoints that pushes work earlier. Do we know what their compliance stance is?

maya_csm: Anya said staging is open to outbound, prod might require VPC peering. We'll default to hosted API for speed; capture Dedicated as a commercial option at D30.

frances_enablement: I'll lead enablement. Proposal: three short sessions instead of two 5 Intro + API runbook, Prompting & eval design, Ops & regression playbook. Recommend product+platform+1 support SME attend.

noor_successops: Risk flag: their procurement window closes at month-end and pilot budget is limited. Add two escalation triggers: (1) by D10 <50% planned test traffic, (2) by D20 eval pass <75%. We'll send a weekly traction brief to exec sponsor (Anya's VP).

eli_se: Tech checklist draft:
- API keys & allowlist steps
- Anonymized support transcript export (sample 1k rows)
- Golden-answer eval set + scoring rubric
- Staging replay (target 8k requests) for p95 testing
- Observability hooks (token counts, error rates, latency)

maya_csm: Timeline (compact):
- Day 0: kickoff + stakeholder alignment
- D05D5: env prep, keys, sample data
- D65D12: integration + smoke tests
- D135D18: enablement sessions + eval runs
- D195D30: polish, exec traction reviews, D30 go/no-go + recommended commercial path

frances_enablement: I'll create a 1-page pre-read and runbook template. Also will include a 6-step daily eval checklist for the customer.

eli_se: I'll build a lightweight test harness and post curl + Postman examples tonight. Also will request a short replay file from customer.

onboard-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Krypton Pilot Kickoff" on 2024-07-09 14:00 PDT 5 invites sent to maya_csm, eli_se, frances_enablement, anya_krypton.

maya_csm: Success criteria (proposed) 5 please confirm edits:
- Integration with sample dataset completed
- >=75% correctness on agreed eval set (rubric-based)
- p95 latency <375ms under replay in staging
- Customer can run daily evals and receive regression alerts
- Weekly traction report delivered to exec sponsor

noor_successops: Add D30 decision: go/no-go + recommended commercial path (hosted usage tier vs Dedicated). I'll draft the traction email and dashboard widgets (usage, eval score, latency, error rate).

maya_csm: Owners recap:
- Integration owner: eli_se
- Enablement & runbook: frances_enablement
- Metrics & traction: noor_successops
- CSM owner: maya_csm

eli_se: Action items: post harness + examples (EOD); request replay file.

frances_enablement: Action items: pre-read + runbook template (by Mon); workshop slides (by D12).

noor_successops: Action items: weekly brief template + dashboard draft (by Wed); wire D10 alert for low traffic.

maya_csm: I'll finalize agenda and attendee list, confirm invitees, and upload the shared checklist after the call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
file_note: Customer mentioned in thread; participants list includes only Redwood employees/bots per metadata rules
